body: I just returned from two good days at Malone University in Canton, Ohio. I leave early tomorrow for two days at Eastern Mennonite University in Harrisonburg, Virginia. So I probably won’t do much blogging this week … but I’m eager to fill everyone in on the tentative title for my next book and my new publisher. Stay tuned. In the meantime, you might want to look through the blog archives here …
